segments.ja332:1.1: Api hantvā hato brūti, jetvā jitoti bhāsati;
segments.ja332:1.3: Pubbavakkhāyino [pubbamakkhāyino (sī. syā.)] rāja, aññadatthu [ekadatthu (sī. pī.)] na saddahe.
segments.ja332:2.3: Ubhinnaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā, yathā dhammo tathā kare.
segments.ja332:3.1: Alaso gihī kāmabhogī na sādhu, asaññato pabbajito na sādhu;
segments.ja332:3.3: Rājā na sādhu anisammakārī, yo paṇḍito kodhano taṃ na sādhu.
segments.ja332:4.3: Nisammakārino rāja [rañño (sī. syā.)], yaso kitti ca vaḍḍhatīti.
